statement: The first line holds n; the second holds n integers. For every element, print the first value to its right that is strictly greater, or -1 when there is none - all answers on one line, space-separated, in the original order. Scan left to right with a stack of indices whose answers are pending, values decreasing from bottom to top. Each new value pops and answers every smaller pending index, then joins the stack itself; leftovers answer -1.

example.why: 8 answers both 6 and 0 the moment it arrives; 3 answers 1; 8 and 3 find nothing after them.

hint: Answer at pop time: the popping value is the first greater one the popped index ever met.
mistake: Rescanning rightward for every element - a descending array turns that quadratic.
